title: A Trial of Lipitor (Atorvastatin) for the Treatment of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) in Women With Elevated Low-density Lipoprotein (LDL) Cholesterol

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy of Lipitor (Atorvastatin) for the treatment of PCOS with elevated LDL cholesterol.

Posted outcomes: Brachial Artery Flow-mediated Dilation (FMD). timeframe=baseline and 6 weeks. Atorvastatin=12.0 (±7.3); Placebo=9.8 (±5.8). p=0.58
